web_events.query: US economic data release this week CPI GDP jobs
web_events.answer: The latest US economic data for this week includes the release of the June jobs report, which showed a dip in the unemployment rate to 4.2% with only 57,000 jobs added in June, significantly lower than the 172,000 jobs added in May. Economists had expected the economy to add around 115,000 jobs for June. The labor market appears to be cooling, with wage growth lagging behind inflation. The GDP and CPI data for this period have not yet been released.

The increase in the PMI was driven by robust export orders, particularly for high-tech products, and a slight recovery in new orders.
